questions.question: What does Ecclesiastes 10 say dead flies do to perfumer's ointment?
options: Give it a stench, as a little folly outweighs wisdom and honor
Spoil only its surface, while all the rest of it remains pure
Make it far more precious, just as trials refine the truly wise
Leave it wholly untouched, for folly cannot ever harm true wisdom
questions.answer: Give it a stench, as a little folly outweighs wisdom and honor

questions.question: What does Ecclesiastes 10 say about digging a pit?
options: He who digs a pit may fall into it
He who digs a pit prepares a snare for his enemy
He who digs a pit grows weary and gains nothing
He who digs a pit will strike water and prosper
questions.answer: He who digs a pit may fall into it

questions.question: Ecclesiastes 10 says a wise man's heart inclines him to the right, but a fool's to the left.
Dead flies make the perfumer's ointment give off a _____.
He who digs a _____ will fall into it.
